dc_power_supply.name: External DC Power Source (Battery)
dc_power_supply.description: External electrical energy source that drives a non-spontaneous redox reaction by converting electrical energy into chemical energy.

positive_anode_electrode.name: Anode (Positive Graphite Electrode)
positive_anode_electrode.description: Electrode connected to the positive terminal of the DC source where oxidation occurs (2Cl⁻(aq) → Cl₂(g) + 2e⁻).

chlorine_gas_bubbles.name: Chlorine Gas Bubbles (Cl₂(g))
chlorine_gas_bubbles.description: Pungent yellowish-green chlorine gas bubbles formed at the anode surface as chloride ions are oxidised.

chloride_anions.name: Chloride Anions (Cl⁻(aq))
chloride_anions.description: Negatively charged chloride anions in solution migrating toward the positively charged anode.

negative_cathode_electrode.name: Cathode (Negative Graphite Electrode)
negative_cathode_electrode.description: Electrode connected to the negative terminal of the DC source where reduction occurs (Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → Cu(s)).

copper_cations.name: Copper(II) Cations (Cu²⁺(aq))
copper_cations.description: Positively charged Cu²⁺ cations in the electrolyte migrating toward the negatively charged cathode.

copper_metal_deposit.name: Reddish-Brown Copper Deposit (Cu(s))
copper_metal_deposit.description: Layer of solid reddish-brown copper metal plated onto the submerged cathode surface during reduction.

aqueous_electrolyte.name: Aqueous Copper(II) Chloride Electrolyte (CuCl₂(aq))
aqueous_electrolyte.description: Conducting aqueous ionic solution containing free mobile Cu²⁺ and Cl⁻ ions.
